title: TASK-034 Stage 0: retrieval-only scoring
not_a_value_result: Retrieval coverage on a small hand-authored dev set; says nothing about answer quality, cost or Dita's value. B-weak is a weak control, not real B.

arms_description.A-full: full visible transcript up to as_of
arms_description.B-weak control: BM25 (LexicalRetriever) + char-n-gram hashing cosine, RRF (HybridRetriever), +/-2 neighbours, T_ctx. NOT real B: no multilingual embedder exists
arms_description.B-weak no-window (diag): DIAGNOSTIC: B-weak retriever without the neighbour window
arms_description.C-today +/-2 (diag): DIAGNOSTIC: C-today retriever with B's +/-2 neighbour window

index_build_ms.what: in-memory store replay to as_of: ingest + RuleLinkInferencer links + DeletionService deletions (corpus + decoy)

timing_protocol: 1 warm-up + 5 timed runs per (question, arm); per (corpus, as_of) for index build; wall clock, single JVM, System.nanoTime
